law: Furigana is the corridor's core teaching surface — the ruby must be TRUE before anything else is. UniDic guesses name readings statistically and shreds rare theonyms; this lexicon carries the human-curated readings for the name compounds the curated shelf actually contains. It is applied at tokenization time (build_corridor.tokenise), proven applied by tools/check_suspect_readings.py, and a reverted build is convicted by verify-native-readings.mjs.

provenance.policy: Token splits stay UniDic's; ONLY readings are overridden, matched on exact adjacent token-surface sequences. Where a deity or person name carries an unwritten genitive の before its final piece, the の attaches to the NAME piece — the same convention UniDic itself already applies to 天之御中主(あめのみなかぬしの) and 太(おおの) — and a name-final 神 token always reads かみ. Readings are hiragana, matching the token 'r' field. A null reading leaves that token untouched (context guard only).

entries.reading: あめのみなかぬしのかみ
entries.note: UniDic keeps the name piece right but reads the orphaned 神 as しん (33 of 35 shelf occurrences). The flagship 検収前 texts introduce this deity; ruby must read あめのみなかぬしのかみ end to end.
UniDic drops the genitive の and reads 神 as しん. The name piece keeps UniDic's たかみむすひ (ひ, per 産巣日=むすひ) and gains the unwritten の.
Name piece keeps UniDic's かみむすび (the common modern rendering; かむむすひ/かみむすひ are attested classical variants) and gains the unwritten genitive の; 神 reads かみ, never しん.

entries.word: 宇摩志阿斯訶備比古遅神
entries.reading: うましあしかびひこぢのかみ
entries.note: UniDic shreds this theonym into dictionary guesses (斯=ここ, 古=ふる, 遅=おそ, 訶備 rubyless). Per-token readings spell うましあしかびひこぢのかみ exactly.

entries.reading: あめのとこたちのかみ
entries.note: UniDic reads 天(てん)・常(つね)・立神(たてがみ). The 神 sits inside the token 立神, so that token carries たちのかみ.
The Kojiki's collective term for the first five deities. UniDic reads it 別(べつ)+天神(てんじん) — Tenjin worship, a different word entirely.
Kojiki spelling with 耶. UniDic leaves 耶 rubyless (い◯なぎかみ). Genitive の rides the final name fragment.
UniDic reads the final token 美神 as びしん. The 神 sits inside that token, so it carries みのかみ.
邪-spelling variant; UniDic already reads the name piece いざなぎの but orphans 神 as しん.
邪-spelling variant; UniDic drops the genitive の and reads 神 as しん.
UniDic reads 少(しょう)名(めい)…神(しん) — しょうめいひこなしん. Per-token readings spell すくなびこなのかみ.
UniDic reads 大国(たいこく)+主神(しゅしん). The 神 sits inside the token 主神, so that token carries ぬしのかみ.

entries.reading: あまてらすおおみかみ
entries.note: UniDic truncates 大御神 to おおみか. No genitive here — 大御 is honorific: おおみかみ.
Alternate name of 高御産巣日神. UniDic reads たかぎ+かみ, dropping the genitive の.

entries.reading: あしはらのなかつくに
entries.note: UniDic reads 葦原(よしわら — the Edo district)+中国(ちゅうごく — the country). The mythic realm reads あしはらのなかつくに.
Where UniDic fuses 三神 into one token it reads it みかみ; the collective term is the on-compound ぞうかさんしん. (The split 造化|三|神 already reads さん+しん correctly — see accepts.)
Standard on-compound (大辞泉). UniDic wavers between しん and かみ across the shelf; the term is そうぞうしん.
Standard on-compound in religious studies (さいこうしん); UniDic reads かみ here.
Standard on-compound (ゆいいつしん); UniDic reads かみ here.
Not a dictionary headword; reads by regular on-composition parallel to 最高神/創造神, matching the essay's own technical register.
UniDic reads ひえた and drops the genitive の. The Kojiki reciter is ひえだのあれ.
UniDic guesses the given-name token 宗 as たかし; the politician reads かみや・そうへい (wikinews:45098).
UniDic leaves 璃菜 rubyless; the actress reads えんどう・りな (wikinews:45095).
The footballer reads ふじた・ジョエル・チマ; UniDic reads 譲 as ゆずる and leaves 瑠 rubyless. じょえる is ateji over 譲瑠; the split anchors on 瑠=る, the character's standard reading (wikinews:44381).
Scholarly convention reads the chronicle にほんしょき; UniDic emits にっぽん for the 日本 token in this compound.
The Kojiki-preface term for Are's recitation practice; UniDic leaves it rubyless. 日国: しょうしゅう.
野ばら (aozora:051034) 「ここは都から遠い…」 — the capital, みやこ; UniDic picked the administrative suffix と. Context-guarded by the surrounding particles; 東京|都(と) tokenizes with 東京 before 都 and never matches.

五箇条の御誓文 「各其志ヲ遂ケ」 — 遂(と)ケ; UniDic emits the on-reading すい on an unknown-word fallback.
五箇条の御誓文 「人心ヲシテ倦マザラシメン」 — 倦(う)む; UniDic leaves both tokens rubyless.
方丈記 「甍を争へる」 — 争(あらそ)へる; UniDic emits the on-reading そう on an unknown-word fallback.

Reviewed CORRECT — administrative suffix 都(と) after 東京 (wikinews:45089). Recorded so the checker's 都(と) probe can tell it from the 野ばら/方丈記 defects; bytes untouched.
